subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers adopt the existing conflicting fork PR as the fix path, or authorize a fresh narrow in-repo fix for the heartbeat prompt guard?
rationale: ClawSweeper should not queue a new fix while an open linked PR with closing syntax exists and this issue is already marked no-new-fix-pr; a maintainer needs to choose the canonical repair path.

options.title: Authorize replacement fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and allow one narrow in-repo fix that guards workspace-path hint injection to default/internal prompts and adds regression tests.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase and repair the existing branch, preserving that contribution as the landing path.

options.title: Defer the fix
options.body: Keep the issue open but do not start repair work until a maintainer prioritizes heartbeat prompt behavior again.

recommendation.title: Authorize replacement fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR and allow one narrow in-repo fix that guards workspace-path hint injection to default/internal prompts and adds regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the broadest recent heartbeat-runner history among the likely owners found in local git history.
